cover.today: An AI agent broke in by itself, a $30B bet on AI agents, and India changes how it pays for AI.

summary.text: An AI agent found a new bug and broke in within 11 minutes.
Claude can now approve routine code by itself.
Sierra raised $1.75B. Its value doubled to $30B.
Amazon is buying Decart’s chip software, ~$7.5B reported.
ERNIE 5.5 Flash: 280B parameters, only 14B work at a time.
GPT-6 designed proteins with reasoning and code.
India’s GPU help will now pay for running AI, not just training it.

summaryNote: Day 02 catches up on 23–25 Nov · from Day 03: strictly the last 24 hours

slides.aka: aka. the attacker was mostly software
slides.p: Attackers aimed an open-source agent at university servers. For 16 hours it tried known tricks. Then it found a bug no one had reported, and was inside in about 11 minutes, mostly on its own.
slides.india: In India: CERT-In gives companies 6 hours to report a cyber incident. This attack took 11 minutes.
slides.src: Amazon Threat Intelligence, via VentureBeat and Gizmodo · CERT-In directions, 2022

slides.p: Claude can now review code, fix it and approve routine changes by itself, using rules a team writes. Risky changes still go to a human.
slides.india: In India: testing and code review are big service lines at our IT majors. Agents now do the routine part. Writing the rules is the new job.

slides.aka: aka. one bet on AI that works, one on AI that’s cheaper

stats.l: Sierra’s value after raising $1.75B. Its AI agents answer customers. Doubled since May.
Amazon buying Decart’s software to make its own AI chips faster. Price reported, not confirmed.

slides.india: In India: same bet, smaller cheque. AidenAI, started by an ex-Infosys executive, raised $32M for enterprise AI agents.
slides.src: Sierra; TechCrunch; GeekWire; Analytics India Magazine · Nov 2026

slides.aka: aka. “mixture of experts”, via baidu’s ERNIE 5.5 flash

il.left: 280 DOTS = 280B PARAMETERS · ONLY 14 LIGHT UP FOR EACH WORD

slides.p: Think of a hospital with 280 doctors. A front desk sends you to the few you need. ERNIE 5.5 Flash works the same way: 280 billion parameters, only about 14 billion used per word.
slides.india: In India: this is how big models get cheap enough to serve at Indian prices. You still need GPUs that hold all 280B. That’s slide 8.
slides.src: Baidu ERNIE release page; AlphaSignal · preview release

slides.aka: aka. a general model doing a specialist’s job
slides.p: OpenAI says GPT-6 designed new proteins by reasoning and writing code, with no special biology model. A partner lab found some designs worked. It’s a preprint, not peer-reviewed.
slides.india: Why it matters: if a general model can do this, expect the same in law, finance and design next.

slides.p: After a row over Sarvam selling access to Chinese open-weight models, MeitY said there was no misuse of IndiaAI support. And GPU help will now cover running models, not only training them.
slides.india: “Now, we need to shift towards how we can support inference.” — S. Krishnan, MeitY Secretary

slides.p: For three years we asked how smart AI is. Now we ask what it’s allowed to do, and what it costs to run.
slides.src: Ladder is my framing · Walmart Agent Gateway, Oct 2026

slides.k: My take · as an AI PM
slides.t: the model was never the hard part
slides.sub: what building AI for indian banks taught me
p: when i worked on voice ai for indian banks, the model was rarely the blocker. the blocker was: what may the bot say about a loan, when must it hand over to a human, and who reads the call log?
this week claude got that kind of rulebook for code. the attacker’s agent had none.
so every agent i spec gets a permission, a limit and a log. and for indian startups, today’s signal is clear: the money is moving to running ai cheaply, in our languages. build for that.
